thread:
Alex R.: Quick SOC2/ISO check-in — I uploaded the draft evidence registry to Confluence and sketched a timeline. Audit firm on-site week of 2024-08-05. We need owners confirmed for:
- KMS key rotation evidence (cloud keys)
- HSM attestation for private deployments
- Audit log retention / integrity proofs
- IAM role for model-serving change

Can folks call out blockers and owners? Also need code-review pings for the KMS/HSM PRs.

Priya S.: KMS rotation PR is ready for review: https://git.redwood/infra/pr/3427
PR includes rotation runbook and automated evidence export (s3). HSM attestation is TBD — vendor sent cert bundle but we need to validate chain. Sample policy we plan to attach:
```
{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/redwood-audit"},"Action":"kms:GenerateDataKey","Resource":"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-efgh"}]}
```
Question: do we need to store the attestation in the same evidence bucket or a separate ledger? @lina_m any compliance preference?

Marco V.: I can review the PR today. For HSM certs, we need a test cert from the vendor to validate the parsing tool I wrote. @priya_s can you get a sanitized sample (no production keys)? If so I'll run local attestation flow and add unit tests.

Tom H.: Audit logs pipeline update — ELK ingest of control-plane logs done, retention policy set to 1 year on cold storage. Need to confirm encryption-at-rest for the S3 export (server-side AES + KMS). Also we should snapshot the log integrity proof (SHA256) daily and export to evidence-bucket.

Jin W.: Heads up — model-serving needs a new IAM role to read the evidence export for canary checks. That role change is a breaking deploy for private clusters; need lead time to schedule canaries. ETA for role PR: Thu.

Lina M.: Suggest we run a mock audit on 2024-08-01 to exercise evidence retrieval and remote attestation. I can coordinate with SOC2 auditor contacts. Prefer storing attestations + hashes in the dedicated evidence-bucket (separate prefix) for immutability and retention. Also: please confirm who will be the on-call contact during audit week.

deploy-bot: Heads up — infra change freeze window begins 2024-08-01 00:00 UTC per release calendar. Emergency fixes only.

audit-bot: @alex_r — auditor (Brightgate LLP) confirms on-site Aug 5-9. They requested a list of people with console access to KMS + HSM test logs by 2024-07-25.

Alex R.: OK next steps and owners (please ack):
- KMS rotation PR & evidence export -> Marco V. (review + merge)
- HSM attestation validation -> Priya S. (obtain sanitized certs)
- Audit log retention + integrity snapshots -> Tom H. (implement daily proof)
- IAM role & canary schedule -> Jin W. (PR by Thu, coordinate canary)
- Mock audit coordination + access list -> Lina M.

Please reply with a quick ack or blockers by EOD today. If you need scoped help, @dev-ex or @eng-sre can assist.

Marco V.: Ack. Will review PR today and post comments.
Priya S.: Ack — I'll request sanitized certs from vendor and add to the PR checklist.
Tom H.: Ack. Will add daily SHA256 snapshot job and document retention path.
Jin W.: Ack. PR targeting Thu; will add canary window in the PR description.
Lina M.: Ack. I'll draft access list template and ping audit contact. Mock audit scheduled 2024-08-01.
Alex R.: Thanks — if no blockers by EOD I'll lock timeline and notify Brightgate.
